title: Issue-flow checks build in the leased slot, not ~/.openagents/coder-one/target
body:
P1.4: issue-flow checks (`confined.rs` `Setup::for_run`) build in a separate `~/.openagents/coder-one/target` (85 GB observed) outside the slot budget, and only full-access runs lease a slot. Route checks through the task's leased slot and lease a slot for every access mode that builds.

From the Paseo worktree gap analysis (docs/worktrees/2026-10-03-paseo-worktree-gap-analysis.md, 61580a0aec), phase 1 (disk).
